data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for 3D rendering using the Filament PBR engine.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter 3D viewer widget and toolkit wrapper for rendering 3D models using the Filament graphics engine. Supports loading glTF/GLB assets, KTX/PNG/JPEG textures, camera manipulation, and skinning/morph animations across mobile, desktop, and web.
use_when: You need to render 3D models (glTF/GLB) inside a Flutter application.
You require a high-performance cross-platform 3D rendering engine using Filament.
You need support for PBR materials, animations, and lighting in mobile, desktop, or web apps.
avoid_when: You are building a standard 2D user interface without any 3D rendering needs.
You want a pure Dart 3D engine without native bindings or external assets.
strengths: Cross-platform support for iOS, macOS, Android, Windows, and Web/WASM.
Powered by the high-performance Filament PBR engine.
Supports glTF assets, textures, camera/entity manipulation, and morph animations.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup or native binary downloads on first build.
Custom materials require compilation via the `matc` tool matching the specific Filament version.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling native-assets (`flutter config --enable-native-assets`) and downloading static binaries on first build.
data.minimal_example:
ViewerWidget(
  assetPath: "assets/cube.glb",
  skyboxPath: "assets/default_env_skybox.ktx",
  iblPath: "assets/default_env_ibl.ktx",
  transformToUnitCube: true,
  initialCameraPosition: Vector3(0, 0, 6),
  background: Colors.blue,
  manipulatorType: ManipulatorType.ORBIT,
)
